summary: PostgreSQL reconciliation succeeded for the recorded run objects. Current-run credentials, backend auth sessions, issued access tokens, sandbox session state, and sandbox execute operation state are all persisted in credbridge_vault. The main live drift is persistence shape: recorded access tokens live in api_tokens while scope_tokens is empty for those IDs; the sandbox runtime's exposed sandbox_id maps to sandbox_sessions.tee_context_id rather than sandbox_sessions.id.
contract_findings: Recorded access token IDs reconciled against credbridge_vault.api_tokens, not credbridge_vault.scope_tokens.
credbridge_vault.scope_tokens returned no rows for the recorded token IDs.
The runtime sandbox_id 3bb759de-662d-4fee-b458-d604552ff237 reconciles to credbridge_vault.sandbox_sessions.tee_context_id, not sandbox_sessions.id.
credbridge_vault.auth_audit_logs returned no rows for the recorded session IDs even though credbridge_vault.audit_logs contains matching auth and credential events.
